_doc: Program-level scope-aware NEGATE registry (Ogie msg 8274, 2026-06-13). Keyed by platform-slug. A NEGATE'd program is deduped (dropped from ranking) when its CURRENT in-scope asset set is a SUBSET of negated_assets. If it adds NEW in-scope assets, the scorer keeps it LIVE and tags new_scope=[only-the-new] (re-scoped = fresh only for the new assets). When negated_assets is [] OR the program-monitor has no current asset data (assets:[]), the gate falls back to slug-level dedup (labeled). NEVER dedup by program-NAME alone — always program+scope. Append a row here on every hunt FORECLOSURE/NEGATE. Asset tokens are normalized: lowercased 0x-address | gh:owner/repo | host/path.
_normalization: etherscan/bscscan/*scan address -> lowercased 0x[40hex]; github.com/owner/repo -> gh:owner/repo; app/website -> hostname; else lowercased url.
